erin: tiny design Q — saved per-route analytics view with a model filter: should the saved object include a routing snapshot (region/tier/fallback) or just a pointer to resolve live? reproducibility vs fragility. pinging @viktor @maria

viktor: i'm leaning live-resolve + explicit snapshot optional. ops changes fast; hard pins make alerts noisy. but we need to let power users freeze the environment.

maria: agree. we should add a compact "snapshot" field only when user explicitly selects "capture environment" in the save modal. default remains live-resolve. snapshot stored as a tiny string (e.g. "eu-west-1|dedicated-high|hint-33|tok_est=1200|lat=140ms") so DB doesn't bloat.

jin: telemetry concern: if default is live, we MUST emit what actually executed when view runs. add saved_view_applied with fields (saved_id, resolved_routing_id, model_rev, sample_rate_float, user_id, route_id). also saved_view_saved should record whether snapshot was captured. without this we can't debug regressions.

viktor: API sketch (pseudo):
```
{version:"4", route:"r-88", model_filter:"open-13b@r2026", filters:"status:error", snapshot:"<opt_string>", policy:"live|snapshot|hard", sampling:"0.05", ui:{title:"..."}}
```
Note: snapshot is optional. policy controls apply-time behavior. keep UI meta small.

erin: for UX — preview should always show two lines: "Snapshot: <if present>" and "Current resolve: <computed>" with small cost/latency delta. default view shows snapshot if policy!=live, otherwise show current. show badge if resolution changed since save.

maria: quota interplay: if a snapshot points to dedicated capacity and the user tries to apply it during contention we must gracefully fallback according to policy. fallback order: snapshot -> route-default -> cheapest-compatible. show a clear reason toast when fallback happens and include telemetry event saved_view_fallback with reason.

jin: sampling semantics: store sampling_owner = route|view|global and sampling_rate as float 0..1. add these to saved_view_applied so analytics aggregation knows how to reweight samples.

viktor: migration plan: read older saved objects (v1) and optional backfill snapshot by calling resolver at low QPS. write new v4 objects with policy="live" if no snapshot requested. background job + idempotent writes. expose old shape in read API for 2 weeks to avoid client breakage.

erin: rollout: gate live-resolve preview behind feature flag initially. A/B 5% first to measure extra resolver latency and errors. if stable, ramp to 50%.

maria: telemetry additions summary: saved_view_saved (snapshot_present boolean, policy), saved_view_previewed (preview_mode: snapshot|live), saved_view_applied (resolved_routing_id, snapshot_present, model_rev, sample_rate, user_id), saved_view_fallback (reason, original_snapshot). will add schemas to analytics repo.

jin: ops note: resolver must return stable "resolved_routing_id" (immutable pointer to {region,tier,compatible_models}) to keep telemetry compact. also keep perf_profile cache per model for preview cost estimates to avoid live profiling on every open.

bot-deploy: queued: savedview-resolver-service deploy @3221112260 (build/7124)

erin: ok owners: viktor -> API + migration RFC, maria -> telemetry + analytics dashboards, jin -> resolver + perf cache, erin -> UX copy + feature flag plan. i'll record decisions in ticket INF-5302. thanks all.
